Yes: the Sustainable Use License allows your company to use n8n for internal business workflows. Do
not resell it, host it for customers, or use the enterprise-only (.ee) parts without a paid licence.
This is a custom licence, not standard open source, so have legal review it if your use may reach
outside your company.

Follow-up
 • Will any workflow or n8n instance be offered to customers or partners outside your company group?
 • Do you need enterprise features such as those marked .ee?

Why
 🟡 Licence: Internal business use allowed; resale, hosting for others and .ee files are restricted.
   • Using n8n for your own company's internal business workflows is permitted.
     "You may use or modify the software only for your own internal business purposes or for non-commercial or…" → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L32-L33 ✔
   • You may not sell n8n or give it to others commercially, for example as a paid product or a
     hosted service for customers.
     "You may distribute the software or provide it to others only if you do so free of charge for non-commercial…" → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L33-L34 ✔
   • Code in files or folders marked .ee is not covered by the standard licence and needs a paid n8n
     Enterprise licence to be used in production.
     "Source code files that contain ".ee." in their filename or ".ee" in their dirname are NOT licensed under" → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L6 ✔

What to do next
 1. Keep n8n use inside your own company and group; do not offer it, or workflows built on it, as a
   paid or hosted service to outside customers without asking n8n for a commercial licence.
     Source: "You may distribute the software or provide it to others only if you do so free of
       charge…"
     → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L33-L34
 2. Do not enable or use enterprise-only features (files or folders with .ee) in production unless
   you buy an n8n Enterprise licence.
     Source: "Source code files that contain ".ee." in their filename or ".ee" in their dirname are
       NOT…"
     → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L6
 3. Have your legal team confirm the fit if any workflow serves external parties, or if you plan to
   modify n8n.
     Source: "You may distribute the software or provide it to others only if you do so free of
       charge…"
     → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L33-L34
